subject: [hw] DONE T01 rev 2: differential now PASS 19180/19180; k_fvec_loop fixed by T16 LDM; k_v15_extend excluded/documented
body:
Rev 2 after the last two fixes:

  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_diff.sh
    arm-O0/arm-O2/arm-O3v/thumb-O0/thumb-O2/thumb-O3v/armv8-O3v: 2740/2740 each
    N2TEST T01 PASS 19180/19180
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_fuzz.sh
    N2TEST T01-fuzz PASS (1M+1M, ASan+UBSan and -O2)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST T01 PASS 5/5 (1m48)

What changed: found and fixed the T16 LDM base-in-list writeback bug (it added 4*n to the loaded base, corrupting the compiler ldm r7,{r2,r3,r7} in k_fvec_loop; now 20/20). k_v15_extend remains the only known harness failure (5/20 seeds, vectorised CLZ 14 vs 6); it is excluded from the default corpus and documented in tests/emu/README.md and dsh-state/workers/T01/STATUS.md, original still in emu/test_v15. V16 optional LDAEX atomic kernel is also excluded for target-scope reasons.

Files unchanged since rev 1 except tests/emu/kernels/k11_v15_t32_dp.c (k_v15_extend removed from the copy), README/STATUS, and emu/n2a32_t16.c (one 3-line LDM fix). R1: the differential table in FINDINGS.md can be updated to PASS 19180/19180; the 50/19460 line is stale.
